reason: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中提供访问模式控制入口，通过 Default/No Edit/Auto 三档模式联动现有会话审批与沙箱策略，从而影响工具调用是否自动放行、是否需审批及可访问范围。

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中提供 Default / No Edit / Auto 三档访问模式切换，帮助用户按需控制会话中的工具访问、审批策略与沙箱权限。
summaries.en: Adds a session access-mode switcher in DeepSeek Harness with Default, No Edit, and Auto presets, letting users control tool access, approval policy, and sandbox behavior.

capabilities: Provides a session-scoped access mode selector (Default, No Edit, Auto) in the DSH web composer
Synchronizes mode with native sandbox and approval settings through session events
Implements pre-execution tool gating for read/edit/write operations and Bash commands
Offers slash commands to query and switch access mode during a session

reasons.code: Can switch sessions to danger-full-access and control approval behavior, including no-approval mode
Replaces native permission preset selector and injects plugin entry into DSH web profile
Targets file and terminal-facing operations via sandbox and tool-policy controls
